

# mofcomp.exe is all Rust (mofcomp-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mofcomp-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# mofcomp.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mofcomp-rust/src/mofcomp/mofcomp.rs)
set(MOFCOMP_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/libwine/libwine.a)
add_cargo_module(mofcomp mofcomp-cargo mofcomp.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE mofcomp-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/wbem
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ${MOFCOMP_REUSED})
